intro.name: Jacob Williams
intro.paragraph: Full stack developer and graduate of CodeBoxx Academy’s AI Native Full Stack Development program who builds web, API and mobile applications with React, Node.js, Java Spring Boot and React Native. Pairs that technical range with 8.5 years of sales experience, including building the internal system behind a wholesale startup’s $5.1M launch. Skilled at turning business needs into clear specs and working software, and at explaining technical decisions in plain language. Recognized for the emotional intelligence and empathic curiosity that build rapport with teammates and users, along with a proven ability to adapt quickly, drive results and exceed targets.
